fit-v1 · 28 keys + one dial · design study

Everything within reach.

A compact mechanical keypad with a quiet silhouette: deep navy caps, white legends, a glossy black deck, and a softly lit frosted base. Explore the assembly, inspect each unique component, and see what is known about the cost.

DRAWINGS-BASED MODELFit, printed materials, optics and electronics remain unvalidated.

Select a key · hold to press · explore the layersAssembled · 4° riser
Custom navy capsWhite per-key lightFrosted baseRGB base light

Uniform shallow-dish caps share one height profile; Space spans two grid cells. The external BOX Jade stem moves with its cap. The lower case encloses an unrouted carrier PCB and component envelopes. Choose one magnetic rear bar at a time; remove it for flat use. Exploded view keeps the soldered stack together. The USB flex is disconnected and omitted while apart.

The known subtotal is not the project total. It includes 30 switches (three ten-packs; 28 installed) and one controller kit. The kit includes the USB adapter and FPC cable, so those are not charged twice. Its supplier listing was out of stock when checked.

BOX Jade30pcs at INR840 + controller kit1 at INR513.30 only. Kit listing out of stock. Excludes every null-priced line, shipping, imports and tax not explicitly included; not a project total. The lower case and both alternative riser bars are separately priced unknown lines. Three overlay concepts are shown; their material, manufacturing process and final purchase quantity need a quote. Shipping, import costs, tools, assembly labour, additional electronics support components and failed prints are not priced.
